description:
Create a global supply chain map in EdrawMax showing the flow of materials for 'Project Phoenix'. 

1. Open EdrawMax and create a new 'World Map' diagram (found under Maps > World Map).
2. Place location markers on these 4 cities: 
   - Seoul, South Korea
   - Hsinchu, Taiwan
   - Shenzhen, China
   - Memphis, USA
3. Add text labels to the locations:
   - Seoul: 'Supplier A (Display)'
   - Hsinchu: 'Supplier B (Chipset)'
   - Shenzhen: 'Assembly Plant'
   - Memphis: 'Global Distribution Hub'
4. Draw directional connectors (arrows) to show the flow:
   - From Seoul to Shenzhen (Dashed line)
   - From Hsinchu to Shenzhen (Dashed line)
   - From Shenzhen to Memphis (Solid line)
5. Add the title 'Project Phoenix Logistics Network' at the top.
6. Save the diagram as '/home/ga/Documents/phoenix_supply_chain.eddx'.
7. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/phoenix_supply_chain.png'.
